description: This file defines the Google OAuth2 provider class for the League OAuth2 client library, including methods for constructing authorization URLs, handling scopes, and domain validation.

classes.name: Google
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for Google, handling authorization URL, token exchange, user info retrieval, scope management, and domain validation.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for Google's OAuth2 authorization endpoint.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for obtaining access tokens from Google.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to fetch user info using the access token.

methods.name: getAuthorizationParameters
methods.description: Prepares and returns authorization parameters, including scope and domain options.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Provides default scopes: openid, email, profile.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the separator used in scope strings (' ').

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks API response for errors and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a GoogleUser object from response data and validates hosted domain.

methods.name: assertMatchingDomain
methods.description: Validates that the user's hosted domain matches the configured domain, throws exception if not.
